target: UniswapX Dutch-order filler class (V3DutchOrderReactor 0x00000000a55e50c71b70db3c8b58749cd1e18eb2; also arbitrum 0xb274d5f4 and base 0x000000008a8330b5): open-decay fills after exclusivity, filled atomically through a DEX in the reactor callback
why: Daily breadth class (rewarded execution / public Dutch auction, non-liquidation): UniswapX is an intended open auction. Swappers sign decaying orders, and once exclusivity ends any filler may settle them. Filling via the reactor callback is one tx (pull input, swap on a DEX, pay output), so a fill contract can revert unless the bot ends higher (L fits). Census run 2685a085 through the relay, last ~1 day, Fill topic 0x78ad7ec0 (scratch/uniswapx-2685-census.json): ethereum 2395 fills / 53 fillers (top-1 0x225a38bc 52%); arbitrum 241 / 7 (0x225a38bc 66%); base 97 / 6 (0x225a38bc 75%, all on V3 Dutch, 0 on the Priority reactor); bsc 200 / 12 (top-1 0x52f9eea3 26%, 0x225a38bc 24%, 0xe0763177 18%, 0x302649cc 9%). optimism/polygon/avalanche: 0 fills in 1 day with reactor code present (unverified zero, no same-chain control). 6 sampled bsc fills (scratch/uniswapx-2685-margin.py): order sizes ~370-1450 USDT-equivalent, gas 3.4-5.9e-5 BNB per fill, tx index 5-94 (not top-of-block), priority 0.05-0.13 gwei. The filler contract keeps 0 net tokens in every sampled tx, so the profit leaves to another address (sink not traced yet). BSC is the least concentrated: 12 fillers, no one above 26%.
next_steps: 1) Per-fill margin: decode the fill calldata (V3 Dutch order: input/outputs, decay start/end blocks, cosigner exclusiveFiller) and price the input vs output at the fill block via the DEX quote. Gross = input value - output value - DEX cost. Do this on 20 bsc fills from ledger uniswapx.fill once its cursor is initialized (python3 tools/ledger-source-coverage.py --source uniswapx.fill). 2) Split fills into exclusive (filler == cosigned exclusiveFiller, i.e. RFQ quoters who need registration = account, out of scope) vs open-decay. Only open-decay fills are takeable. 3) Timing class: blocks from decayStartBlock to the fill block for open fills. If most open fills land within 1-2 blocks of the first profitable block, it is a filler race (blocked/speed); if margins persist several blocks, it is catchable. 4) Order intake: fillers learn of open orders off-chain. Check whether a keyless public UniswapX order endpoint exists in Uniswap's filler docs (docs.uniswap.org/contracts/uniswapx/guides/createfiller); if it needs a key or account, that is a human proposal. 5) Close as dead_end if open-decay gross minus gas is < 1 USD/day at the farm's share, or if open fills are same-block races.
